articles.excerpt:
Indian equities ended the first half of FY27 under pressure, with September emerging as the weakest month for the Nifty 50 since 2018 as elevated crude prices, higher global bond yields and sustained foreign selling weighed on sentiment.

The Nifty 50 closed September at 22,620.45, down 6.1 per cent during the month. For the first half, NSE 50 index gained 1.3 per cent.
